A '''Comlink Signal Booster''' was equipment fitted to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as the [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid]]. The booster allowed the droid's internal [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to transmit to [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="EGTD" />
